attributes.name: Pillar of Life
attributes.powers: Display this card next to your location. While displayed, each character at this location adds 1d8 and the Magic trait to his checks against banes that have the Undead trait. Instead of the first exploration of his turn, any character at this location may shuffle 1d4+1 random cards from his discard pile into his deck.
attributes.recharge: At the end of your turn, if you do not have the Divine skill, banish this card; otherwise, discard it, or you may succeed at a Divine 14 check to recharge it instead.
